result.summary: Validated lib/letflow/design/q929-vortex-8d-corrective-action-subprocess.md. Code reads: build_completion_multi_from_merge/12 (sub_process.ex ~824-905) does bind advance_until_stable's third element to _more_pending and the first Transition.transition result to _pending_events, so dispatch/timer/escalation events are indeed dropped on the sub-process completion path; build_completion_write_steps/12 writes only task activation, token reconciliation, SUB_PROCESS_COMPLETED event, parent projection and grandparent cascade. Engine.complete_task/3 (engine.ex ~3735-3775 and ~4060-4115) consumes the same events via prepare_timer_arms/4 + prepare_service_task_dispatch_for_completion/8 and build_timer_arms_multi/4 + build_service_task_dispatch_multi/5 with an identity id_map (tenant_id from TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1, step name keyed by token_record_id), which is exactly what the design proposes to reuse, so the fix is correct and minimal (one @doc false public wrapper in Engine, one extra parameter on a private SubProcess function; no helper renamed). Timer arms and dispatch rows both covered (E1 SERVICE_TASK, E2 TIMER, E3 escalation HUMAN_TASK, E6 real fixtures). Transaction-safe: all inserts are Multi steps appended after the reconciliation step (TokenRecord FK satisfied), same schema prefix, no new transaction boundary; errors map to the existing to_error_args activation_failed channel handled by the callers' ExecutionError fallback. advance_until_stable/4 (engine.ex ~1413) accumulates only its own hops' events, so concatenating the first-transition events with the hop events does not duplicate the dispatch. No route, authz, response-shape, or tenant-derivation change; SECURITY-REVIEWER skip rationale is sound but ORCH decides. Persona flips complete: grep of test/ for role-procurement-manager finds only persona_actor_seed_drift_test.exs (lines 163-164 refute, M2 at 178-186) plus doc mentions; literal count 4 appears at drift-test lines 30 (@tenants vortex count), 184 (M2) and 217 (M6); the ROLES-held-by-nobody check is satisfied once felix holds the role; no other test reads vortex ROLES. EO-002/EO-003 map to design sections 4-5, 7, E1, E6. ISS-0929 scope touches no QA data (section 0, 9). Design contains JSON fixture shapes and one @spec only, no function bodies. Not run: the design's section 2 probe was not re-executed (the probe file was deleted; findings are consistent with the code read) and the new test files do not exist yet.

issues.description: Drift-test count literals not enumerated: ELIXIR-DEV/TEST-DESIGNER must update lines 30 (count: 4 -> 5), 184 (M2, rewritten) and 217 (M6, roles_errors(..., 4) -> 5). Design says 'search for every literal 4', which suffices, but these are the three sites.

Ambiguity to resolve at build time: section 3.1 says 'two Multi.merge steps' but the section 3.2 wrapper is eager (returns {:ok, multi} | {:error, _}) and errors must be returned from build_completion_multi_from_merge/12. Implement as: run the wrapper eagerly while building the write steps (build_completion_write_steps must be split or return a tagged tuple so the error becomes the existing to_error_args activation_failed shape); do not use lazy Multi.merge for the prepare phase, or the error cannot be routed. Section 3.1 dedupe by {tag, token_id, node_id} is stated as conditional; if a duplicate is ever observed it must be deduped unconditionally because duplicate step names raise.

Stale prose beyond the single sentence the design lists: lib/letflow/design/iss0931-meridian-vortex-persona-actor-provisioning.md also states procurement absent at lines ~110, 187, 197, 236, and test/specs/ISS-0931.md line 7. Optional doc cleanup; not a gate item.

Follow-up issues ORCH must file (as the design states): SUB_PROCESS directly after a completed SUB_PROCESS not activated (3.4); SERVICE_TASK body_template not rendered (Q-926); stale HUMAN_TASK escalation timer. The sync-child (START-to-END) Multi-collision caveat is out of scope. started_at null on this handoff left per protocol.
